quotes: Why did you choose this course?

sources.notes: Fetch returned HTTP 403; quotes are from the search-result snippet of this page. Snippet also says: think about 'the relevance of your course to your future career path ... why you are progressing to this course and how it relates to your previous study'; 'how you are funding your studies. If the funds have come from a large transaction such as a sale of land, you should be prepared to talk about that'.

sources.title: Potential credibility interview questions (University of South Wales PDF, 05/06/14)
quotes: Why did you choose this course?
How will your course be assessed?
Why did you choose to study in the UK?
Why did you choose to study at the University of South Wales?
What facilities at the University of South Wales particularly attracted you?
How are you funding your studies?
If you have taken out a bank loan to finance your studies, how do you intend to repay it?
If you have dependants travelling with you, what will they be doing while you are studying?
Where do you intend to live while you are in the UK? Have you already arranged accommodation?
How are you planning on travelling to the University?
What do you plan to do after you finish your course?
If you intend to return home to seek employment, which companies do you hope to apply to?
How is your course relevant to your future plans?
If you intend to stay in the UK for further study, what do you plan to do?
sources.notes: USW-hosted PDF (2014) extracted locally with pypdf. 'not an exhaustive list'. Also: 'if you are expected to undertake a pre-sessional English course prior to your main course please mention this in your interview.'
